title: Live report coverage depends on metric-name prefix
status: diagnostic_only; no product or test implementation
criterion: Core must not infer experiment validity from domain-specific metric names; equivalent declared finite metric values must not change qualification solely on a rename.

execution.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from orze.reporting.evidence import qualify_local_report_evidence
source=Path('src/orze/reporting/evidence.py')
before=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='orze-v1-live-coverage-review-') as private:
    folder=Path(private)/'idea-case'
    folder.mkdir()
    outcomes=[]
    for label,key in [('generic_name','loss_a'),('renamed_only','wer_a')]:
        metrics={'status':'COMPLETED','objective':0,key:1,'loss_b':2}
        (folder/'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(metrics),encoding='utf-8')
        report={'primary_metric':'objective','sort':'ascending','columns':[{'key':key},{'key':'loss_b'}],'min_datasets':2}
        _,values,value,reason=qualify_local_report_evidence(folder,{'report':report})
        outcomes.append((value,reason))
        print(json.dumps({'case':label,'values':values,'qualified_value':value,'reason':reason}),flush=True)
    _,_,value,reason=qualify_local_report_evidence(folder,{'report':{**report,'min_datasets':0}})
    assert value==0 and reason=='local_evidence_verified'
    assert outcomes[0]==(0.0,'local_evidence_verified')
    after=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert before==after
    print(json.dumps({'controls':'original generic naming and disabled coverage both qualified','source_sha256':after,'source_pre_post_exact':True,'scope':'actual live qualifier over private temporary metrics; no Lake, worker, pytest, or repository edit'}),flush=True)
    assert outcomes[1]==outcomes[0], 'renaming one finite declared dataset column must not change qualification'
PY

interpretation: The live public qualifier loaded actual metrics.json from a private temporary project. Renaming loss_a to wer_a in both report.columns and metrics changed eligible evidence to ineligible evidence although all numeric values and the minimum were unchanged.
The final assertion is a real behavior failure, not an import/API-absence failure. The script is not a pytest run or a frozen new regression test.

Current report.columns are presentation/source declarations, not an explicit dataset coverage schema. The fix should add explicit coverage declarations rather than preserve either legacy prefix inference or the all-columns fallback.
S1 characterized and preserved this old behavior; its successful tests do not establish domain-neutral qualification. This is not an S2 claim-reader defect.

safety_and_limits.diagnostic_scope: One actual live qualification path and two controls; not universal report-consumer acceptance.

proposed_contract_not_implemented: Use explicit report.dataset_keys, or a validated benchmark_contract.required_metrics declaration when dataset_keys is absent.
When min_datasets > 0 and neither explicit coverage declaration exists, fail closed. With min_datasets absent or zero, existing no-coverage ranking remains supported.
Remove live wer-prefix and undeclared-column fallbacks; preserve the separately named non-authoritative legacy archive metric helper.
Bind the new declaration into leaderboard cache and champion-history objective scope; direct qualifier and configuration validation must agree.
Legacy positive-coverage configurations require explicit declaration migration where no benchmark declaration already supplies it; preserve thresholds and business assertions.
